notes: RULINGS: (1) sex=female accepted as correct — 'my mother' states sex by direct implication; this single qualifier makes the patient identifiable, hence is_complete=true. (2) suspect_drug normalized to catalog name 'Cardiofex' despite source spellings 'Cardioflex'/'cardiofex'; verbatim spellings are evidence, not the expected value. (3) reporter_category canonical value 'consumer' — daughter of patient is a non-HCP reporter; scorer should treat 'consumer/family member' variants as this category. (4) All seriousness facts false: reporter's word 'serious' is lay vocabulary, not an ICH E2A criterion; dizziness/nausea/hyperventilation self-resolved within 2 hours, no medical attention sought, no criterion met. (5) must_not_invent: any non-null age_years or initials is a scored hallucination failure.
